title: 1:1 prep - Carlos Martinez (Mar 4)
content:
Goal: quick sync to unblock Carlos for Q1 deliverables, check on career growth, and set 2-3 concrete action items.

Agenda:
- Wins / quick pulse (5m)
  - Ask about small wins since last week (PRs merged, infra incidents reduced)
- Blockers & support needed (10m)
  - JIRA-PLAT-342: latency regression on KV cache rollout (he owns)
- Career / growth check (10m)
  - IC4 path, mentorship, system design opportunities
- Action items & next steps (5m)
notes: Carlos is stressed about the latency regression and worried about RCA taking too long.
PR #1289 is blocked by infra tests flakiness - asked for help from QA lead Priya.
Wants to ramp up on cross-region routing but bandwidth is limited this sprint.
action_items: Carlos: finish the initial RCA doc for JIRA-PLAT-342 by 2026-03-06 and link findings to the ticket
Maya: connect Carlos with Priya (QA) to stabilize infra tests - intro sent in slack; follow up by 2026-03-05
Carlos: schedule 1h pairing with Ben for cross-region routing design by 2026-03-10
career_discussion: Carlos is interested in IC4 expectations (mentorship + system design). Map concrete signals: ownership of rollout, incident response lead, cross-team design sessions. Offer to sponsor him for the next IC4 calibration - propose milestones for Q2.
follow_up_plan:
- Check-in on RCA in next 1:1 (2026-03-11)
- If RCA shows infra-level cause, escalate to release-eng and set hotfix plan
- Add a short blameless postmortem template to the JIRA ticket once RCA is done
